title: Componentwise invertibility of the refinement-restriction map
statement: For every M : DerivedCategory (pbcModules X (R.ring X)), the specified map refinementRestriction R r hi M is an isomorphism.

source.place: Tags 0F7B and 0F7I, clopen restriction to the distinguished section.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0F7B and 0F7I; factorization into compositor and clopen proper counit.

from.place: Componentwise invertibility substep of the refinement restriction proof.

proof.text: Use the factorization of the specified component as the pullback compositor followed by the pulled-back proper counit. The compositor is the hom of an iso, and the proper-counit factor is supplied by lem-sf-refinement-open-restriction-proper-counit-is-iso; composition of isomorphisms gives the result.

lean.statement: theorem refinementRestriction_component_isIso (M : DerivedCategory (pbcModules X (R.ring X))) : IsIso (refinementRestriction R r hi M)
